title: 16. Preservando o fio tênue e avançando

queries.text: “(rs)” is the Brazilian internet abbreviation for “risos” (laughter); rendered “(ha ha)” here and in 17-0012. Alternative: “(lol)” or omitting it. The Lévi phrase is translated from the author’s Portuguese; compare Waite’s public-domain “Transcendental Magic” (1896).
